title: Drift Experience Japan: Supporter Edition
description:
Drift Experience Japan is a small, experience oriented game.
Experience modern Assets developed by gifted creators using the unreal Engine 5.
Drift Experience Japan: Supporter Edition gives you extra content to your game and a Bonus Mode.
Experience the roads around Haruna, Hakone, Gunma, a garage, a practice- and a race track.TracksChoose between the tracks and select day and at night settings.
DriftThe car has an challenging arcade drift handling and can be controlled by keyboard or gamepad.
It may take some to time to get used to it.
CustomizationFully customize your car. Change tires, different body parts, paint.
Customization is available in Gunma, Haruna, garage and on practice track. Use a prebuild setup in Hakone and on the race track with modified setups!
BonusBonus RC Stunt Mode: Try to collect all stars!

• 6 circuits

• day / night settings for 4 circuits

• car customizing in 3 circuits (Haruna, Gunma, Practice)

• challenging arcade drift physics 

• RC Bonus
description_short: Get the Supporter Edition of Drift Experience Japan and enhance your experience with new maps and extra content!
